I want to plot both the error and the corrected error versus the time on

ggplot2?

Hi,

I was going to suggest this

ggplot(melt(errors, meas=c("Error", "CorrError"))) +
geom_path(aes(time, value, colour=variable, group =
interaction(Airport,Runway,OnTime)))

but the result seems very messy. Not sure what's wrong..

baptiste
